$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.2.0-draft (pre-1.0). Mirrors backend/services/api/schemas.py InvestigationReadModel: the nine InvestigationResponse fields that GET /v1/investigations/{id} returns today plus processing_status, job and report. The live route adopts the three new fields in #19 part 2 / #33; the round-trip fixtures under fixtures/results are produced from the Pydantic model.
title: Investigation
description: Read model of one investigation (a check), returned by POST /v1/investigations (202), GET /v1/investigations/{id} and as items of GET /v1/investigations. Processing progress (processing_status), the coarse stored state, the current job and the published report are separate fields: a failed or cancelled investigation carries an error and no report, so a failure can never be read as a finding. Clients map unknown state, stage, processing_status, job and report enum values to UNKNOWN and keep reading the rest of the payload.

stage.description: Stage the investigation is at or stopped at. intake until the job engine picks it up.

version.description: Current report version number, starting at 1 at intake. Equals report.version when a report is present.

error.description: Null unless processing failed. The stored subset of the shared error shape (error.schema.json): code, message and retryable. request_id is absent because a stored failure is not tied to the request that reads it, and action is not stored today.

job.description: The current or last queue job, or null before the job engine has one (intake) or after deletion.

report.description: The latest published report version, or null when nothing has been published. Present for partial and complete; always null for waiting, checking and failed.

oneOf.$comment: A report version is published; cancelled keeps what was published before the cancel.
Failed: the error is present and there are no findings.

coverage.description: How much of the eligible media has been checked. Never a verdict. The intake placeholder is {"status": "not_started"}.

covered_ms.description: Milliseconds of media that reached assessment.

total_ms.description: Eligible media duration in milliseconds, once known.

safe_error.description: Stored failure: the code, message and retryable fields of error.schema.json, by reference so there is one definition of each.

source.description: Echo of the accepted source. URL/upload match investigation-create-request.schema.json, with duration_ms omitted when undeclared. Capture sources are created by POST /v1/captures, never by the shared-media create endpoint.
